protocol.sampleOrder: metrics-before, process CPU before, advance, optional paired Runtime.evaluate workload with native CPU readings around it, process CPU after, metrics-after; final state/export/diagnostics/hashing after the measured CPU end read

positiveControl.kind: synchronous local integer loop in the already-loaded game page

protocol.priorAttempt: Development attempts 1 and 2 were interrupted before a complete run: attempt 1 timed out in Runtime.callFunctionOn during the instrumented diagnostic; attempt 2 recorded three cold controls then exposed a rounded calibration-rate defect before a treatment. Attempt 3 is retained as p46-renderer-cpu-readiness-attempt3-invalid-dose.json: nine cold controls, two warm controls, and the diagnostic completed with process identity and parity, but the predeclared 250M loop cap rejected the calibrated 10% dose, so no paired controls ran. Attempt 3 is excluded from paired-effect estimates; its control and calibration rows remain available for audit.

positiveControlCalibration.source: direct SystemInfo.getProcessInfo renderer CPU delta; no virtual/performance timer used

callbackGcDiagnostic.instrumentationNote: Diagnostic only. Callback timing, nativeTrace, eaPerformance phase timers, and PerformanceObserver GC collection are excluded from CPU comparisons.

warmupControls.note: These start timing after 160 game periods, so their measured start state differs from cold P22 windows; compare the two warm controls only.

measurementReadiness.acceptanceRule: Both counterbalanced paired CPU effects are positive, the two-sided 95% paired t interval excludes zero, and mean paired effect recovers 75–125% of the directly measured native renderer workload.

analysis.allocatorAdmission: not admitted; the 2% renderer CPU decision remains unresolved
